title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Dipsacus wine-root preparation stops at wax consistency before application and optional storage
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Lonitzer Dipsacus says a root cooked in wine until it takes wax consistency heals specified lesions when smeared; the resulting medication can be stored in an earthenware vessel for a year and also treats hanging warts. Preserve the ordered preparation endpoint, application condition, and the same resulting medication across capability assertions. Wax is a consistency comparison, not an added ingredient; storage is a capability, not an obligatory next operation. No target meaning is selected.

design.architecture: root plus wine -> cooking until consistency endpoint -> prepared medication; application-conditioned effect -> optional storage capability of same product
constraints: Keep cerae crassitiem as endpoint analogy; no wax addition is specified.
Keep illita as application condition of the prepared root medication rather than standalone material state.
Quod medicamentum retains resulting product identity; recondi potest asserts capability and does not prescribe actual storage.
Do not infer every efficacy assertion to be a new operation or prove modern efficacy.

source_evidence.quote: In vino cocta radix usque dum cerae crassitiem assumat, rimas fistulasque sedis illita sanat. Quod medicamentum in testaceo vase ad annuum tempus recondi potest: verrucas quoque pensiles curat.

design.duplication_limits: Bounded navigation found IDEA000795 oil/wax additive branch and Dipsacus IDEA000808/809. This proposed consistency endpoint plus storage capability differs in stated source architecture; lexical navigation does not establish novelty.
